purpose: Retain truthful bounded images from existing train forwards, including before a later failure, without changing learning or producing historical replacement images

capture.source: detached contiguous CPU FP32 copy of the existing generator prediction; no extra forward
capture.failureReference: only a previously captured frame with its original identity; no image when no prior capture
capture.modelBindingMeaning: model identity metadata, not a checkpoint or a snapshot of weights at this step

storage.unregisteredPartialWrite: not a valid viewable artifact; retain accurate error and original training first failure
storage.insufficientBudget: record preview unavailable without consuming failure reserves or retrying training

adoptionRequirements: New candidate binds actual producer, writer and query adapter source; preserve old consumed package and policy bytes
Verify trusted identities from existing plan/readers, do not trust syntactically valid SHA strings
Verify no tensor, RNG, model state, optimizer or gradient change by component observation
Verify normal, failure, budget and stale/mismatched artifact cases through existing interfaces
Inactive component metadata remains explicitly component-only until separately versioned production adoption; component-only tests cannot certify it

predecessor.role: unchanged component-only contract; no production qualification inherited

recordContract.modelBindingMeaning: Verified model identity metadata; not a snapshot of mutable weights at the captured step
recordContract.counterRule: G=(epoch-1)*48+trainOrdinal and D=G+1; retain actual distinct counters, no invented completion
recordContract.worldRule: worldId is the verified sample world identity, not a filesystem slug; tick is an actual nonnegative safe integer

manifestContract.failureReference: Optional separately bound JSON referencing a previously committed image and its original sample/count/time; never a newly rendered failure image

projection.label: 未审核训练预览（非Checkpoint／非正式输出）
projection.source: Same-Run trusted terminal manifest or same-Run trusted progress latest entry; never directory discovery

sourceVersioning: Fresh candidate plan and package collect/recompute actual producer, storage, policy, tests and query-adapter identities; existing consumed packages and current production adoption remain unchanged until their own acceptance

resourceAccountingPhases.captureOpen: Keep original failure tensor, failure metadata and worker-terminal reserves; account all actual bytes and staging
resourceAccountingPhases.terminalMetadataOnly: finish irreversibly disables captures and can only publish one bounded failure-reference and manifest. Already saved failure bytes are counted once; keep64KiB worker-terminal reserve and unchanged128MiB execution/4MiB subtree ceilings. No image, model operation or late capture is allowed in this phase.
